objective: Remove the physical coordinate-alignment hypothesis at nullity two, then test whether the resulting U<=2I endpoint transfers to a concrete GU inequality and locate the first failure of the fiber mechanism.
prior_status: H,U<=2I was proved only when the two-dimensional kernel was spanned by physical coordinate vectors; dense physical orientations were unpaid.
mathematical_delta: Removed coordinate alignment completely at nullity two by combining exact coset entropy with forced half-influence on every nonzero physical column and a sharp directional two-bit lemma. Certified a genuine nullity-three shield with H-2I=0.216917... and an exact nullity-two GU calibration G/I=277/96>2. Frozen G<=3I on the enlarged class as the next open inequality.

case_extension.new_class: all rank-(m-2) physical shields with arbitrary Boolean cores
case_extension.parameters: all s,m, affine phases, biases, zero-column counts k=0,1,2, and kernel orientations

acceptance_evidence: Complete all-parameter physical-basis proof plus direct Walsh checker and exact finite boundary/calibration witnesses; independent A086/A094 review remains required.
remaining_obstacle: The class is not restriction closed. The exact fiber entropy decomposition does not control the aggregate upper-set KL/asymmetry mismatch, and G<=3I is unproved even on the enlarged nullity-two class.
next_action: Apply Delta_i U=B_i-Gamma_i+K_i to the rank-(m-2) spectral repetition law and attempt G<=3I by pairing aggregate K_i with the forced half-influences; test against the exact 277/96 witness.
